_readme: Pairs the base-normalized (accent/breathing-insensitive) matcher in scripts/greek-lemma-match.mjs would otherwise merge, but which are genuinely different Greek words distinguished only by accent position or breathing mark — a real class of minimal pairs in Greek, not an orthographic convention difference. Found by manually reviewing every one of the ~270 distinct fuzzy matches build-lxx.mjs produced and checking each against standard Greek lexical knowledge. Key is "lxxLemma|ntLemma" exactly as scripts/build-lxx.mjs's bridge log records it.

blocked.ἦ|ἤ: ἦ = the particle "truly/surely" (or a form of εἰμί); ἤ = "or" — different words, not an accent-marking variant of one
blocked.πως|πῶς: πως (enclitic) = indefinite "somehow"; πῶς (accented) = interrogative "how?" — the same accent-marks-a-different-word pattern as τις/τίς, which the app already keeps separate
blocked.νομός|νόμος: νομός = "pasture, district"; νόμος = "law" — a well-known Greek minimal pair distinguished purely by accent position; merging would mix pasture-references into the NT's central "law" vocabulary
blocked.ὅρος|ὄρος: ὅρος (rough breathing) = "boundary, limit"; ὄρος (smooth breathing) = "mountain" — different words
blocked.βασίλεια|βασιλεία: βασίλεια = "queen" (or neuter plural "royal residence"); βασιλεία = "kingdom" — different words, not a spelling variant of one
blocked.θέα|θεά: θέα = "a sight, spectacle"; θεά = "goddess" — different words
blocked.ἄγνος|ἁγνός: ἄγνος (smooth breathing) = "chaste tree" (a plant); ἁγνός (rough breathing) = "pure, holy" — different words
blocked.εἶμι|εἰμί: εἶμι = "to go"; εἰμί = "to be" — distinct verbs in careful Greek grammar despite the similar spelling
blocked.κάλως|καλῶς: κάλως = "a ship's rope/cable" (Acts 27:40); καλῶς = "well, rightly" — different words
blocked.φαρμακός|φάρμακος: kept separate out of caution rather than confirmed certainty: φαρμακός traditionally denotes a person ("sorcerer"), the accent-shifted form a more general/uncertain sense — occurs in salient denunciation passages (Rev 21:8, 22:15), so a wrong merge here would be unusually visible
blocked.κληρόνομος|κληρονόμος: low confidence either way; kept separate rather than risk mixing into the common NT word for "heir"
blocked.πρωτοτόκος|πρωτότοκος: low confidence either way; kept separate rather than risk mixing into the common NT word for "firstborn"
blocked.οἰκόνομος|οἰκονόμος: low confidence either way; kept separate rather than risk mixing into the common NT word for "steward"
blocked.οἰκόδομος|οἰκοδόμος: low confidence either way; kept separate rather than risk mixing into the common NT word for "builder"
